# Camp Resource: Morbid Well

Become more self-sufficient with the Morbid Well Collector.

- Collects blood over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Morbid Well Collector__

**Produces**

Blood Pack - 14.28%

Irradiated Blood Pack - 14.28%

Tick Blood - 14.28%

Empty Blood Sac - 28.57%

Ichor Sac - 14.28%

Blood Sac - 14.28%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 pound

**Obtainable via**

Fallout First Exclusive - August 2022

**Produces X amount per**

Every 7 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
